 SK hynix operates a memory and storage business with DRAM and NAND products. Its Xetra listing was last quoted at EUR 820.00 on October 16, 2026. 
 Business model and dated reference
 SK hynix operates a memory and storage business centered on DRAM, NAND storage and SSD products.
 The Xetra reference date is October 16, 2026.

 The latest Xetra reference
 October 16, 2026 is the reference date for the latest completed Xetra session. The first price of the day is shown from the start of trading by the continuously updated real-time quote of SK Hynix stock .
 Products and market context
 SK hynix lists DRAM, CMM, SSD, NAND Storage, MCP AI, server, networking, mobile, PC, consumer and automotive products on its corporate website. Its investor-relations site identifies the company in Icheon, South Korea.
